mapper.sql: ( 5 * (s.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.keyword}, '%')) + IFNULL(4 * (s.name_pinyin_first LIKE CONCAT(#{req.pinyinKeyword}, '%') AND CHAR_LENGTH(#{req.pinyinKeyword}) >= 2), 0) + IFNULL(3 * (s.name_pinyin LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.pinyinKeyword}, '%')), 0) + 3 * (s.artist_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.keyword}, '%')) + IFNULL(3 * (s.artist_name_pinyin LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.pinyinKeyword}, '%')), 0) + IFNULL(2 * (s.album_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.keyword}, '%')), 0) + IFNULL(2 * (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_song_tag st JOIN t_tag t ON t.id = st.tag_id WHERE st.song_id = s.id AND t.status = 1 AND t.deleted = 0 AND t.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.keyword}, '%'))), 0) + IFNULL(1 * (ly.plain LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.keyword}, '%')), 0) )
LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT REGEXP_REPLACE(l.content, '\\[[^]]*\\]', '') AS plain FROM t_lyric l WHERE l.song_id = s.id AND l.deleted = 0 LIMIT 1 ) ly ON TRUE

choose.otherwise: score DESC, s.hot_score DESC, s.id DESC

mapper.sql: s.id, s.name, s.artist_id, s.artist_name, s.album_id, s.album_name, s.cover, s.language, s.genre, s.era, s.duration, s.hot_score, s.copyright_status, s.publish_time, IFNULL(s.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.keyword}, '%'), 0) AS mt_name, IFNULL(s.name_pinyin LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.pinyinKeyword}, '%'), 0) AS mt_name_pinyin, IFNULL(s.name_pinyin_first LIKE CONCAT(#{req.pinyinKeyword}, '%') AND CHAR_LENGTH(#{req.pinyinKeyword}) >= 2, 0) AS mt_name_pinyin_first, IFNULL(s.artist_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.keyword}, '%'), 0) AS mt_artist_name, IFNULL(s.artist_name_pinyin LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.pinyinKeyword}, '%'), 0) AS mt_artist_name_pinyin, IFNULL(s.album_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.keyword}, '%'), 0) AS mt_album_name, IFNULL(EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_song_tag st JOIN t_tag t ON t.id = st.tag_id WHERE st.song_id = s.id AND t.status = 1 AND t.deleted = 0 AND t.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.keyword}, '%')), 0) AS mt_tag, , IF (ly.plain LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.keyword}, '%'), SUBSTRING(ly.plain, GREATEST(1, LOCATE(#{req.keyword}, ly.plain) - 30), CHAR_LENGTH(#{req.keyword}) + 60), NULL) AS lyric_fragment
mapper.select:

SELECT a.id, a.name, a.avatar AS cover, a.song_count, a.hot_score, ( 5 * (a.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.keyword}, '%')) + IFNULL(4 * (a.name_pinyin_first LIKE CONCAT(#{req.pinyinKeyword}, '%') AND CHAR_LENGTH(#{req.pinyinKeyword}) >= 2), 0) + IFNULL(3 * (a.name_pinyin LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.pinyinKeyword}, '%')), 0) + IFNULL(2 * (a.alias LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.keyword}, '%')), 0) ) AS score,
IFNULL(a.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.keyword}, '%'), 0) AS mt_name, IFNULL(a.name_pinyin LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.pinyinKeyword}, '%'), 0) AS mt_name_pinyin, IFNULL(a.name_pinyin_first LIKE CONCAT(#{req.pinyinKeyword}, '%') AND CHAR_LENGTH(#{req.pinyinKeyword}) >= 2, 0) AS mt_name_pinyin_first, IFNULL(a.alias LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.keyword}, '%'), 0) AS mt_alias FROM t_artist a WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.status = 1 HAVING score > 0
AND (score, a.hot_score, a.id) < (#{pos.score}, #{pos.hotScore}, #{pos.id})
ORDER BY score DESC, a.hot_score DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT a.id, ( 5 * (a.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.keyword}, '%')) + IFNULL(4 * (a.name_pinyin_first LIKE CONCAT(#{req.pinyinKeyword}, '%') AND CHAR_LENGTH(#{req.pinyinKeyword}) >= 2), 0) + IFNULL(3 * (a.name_pinyin LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.pinyinKeyword}, '%')), 0) + IFNULL(2 * (a.alias LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.keyword}, '%')), 0) ) AS score FROM t_artist a WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.status = 1 HAVING score > 0 ) c

SELECT al.id, al.name, al.cover, al.artist_id, al.artist_name, al.song_count, al.publish_date AS publish_time, al.hot_score, ( 5 * (al.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.keyword}, '%')) + IFNULL(4 * (al.name_pinyin_first LIKE CONCAT(#{req.pinyinKeyword}, '%') AND CHAR_LENGTH(#{req.pinyinKeyword}) >= 2), 0) + IFNULL(3 * (al.name_pinyin LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.pinyinKeyword}, '%')), 0) + IFNULL(2 * (al.artist_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.keyword}, '%')), 0) ) AS score,
IFNULL(al.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.keyword}, '%'), 0) AS mt_name, IFNULL(al.name_pinyin LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.pinyinKeyword}, '%'), 0) AS mt_name_pinyin, IFNULL(al.name_pinyin_first LIKE CONCAT(#{req.pinyinKeyword}, '%') AND CHAR_LENGTH(#{req.pinyinKeyword}) >= 2, 0) AS mt_name_pinyin_first, IFNULL(al.artist_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.keyword}, '%'), 0) AS mt_artist_name FROM t_album al WHERE al.deleted = 0 AND al.status = 1 HAVING score > 0
AND (score, al.hot_score, al.id) < (#{pos.score}, #{pos.hotScore}, #{pos.id})
ORDER BY score DESC, al.hot_score DESC, al.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT al.id, ( 5 * (al.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.keyword}, '%')) + IFNULL(4 * (al.name_pinyin_first LIKE CONCAT(#{req.pinyinKeyword}, '%') AND CHAR_LENGTH(#{req.pinyinKeyword}) >= 2), 0) + IFNULL(3 * (al.name_pinyin LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.pinyinKeyword}, '%')), 0) + IFNULL(2 * (al.artist_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.keyword}, '%')), 0) ) AS score FROM t_album al WHERE al.deleted = 0 AND al.status = 1 HAVING score > 0 ) c

SELECT p.id, p.name, p.cover, p.song_count, p.play_count, p.hot_score, ( 5 * (p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.keyword}, '%')) + IFNULL(2 * (p.tags LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.keyword}, '%')), 0) ) AS score,
IFNULL(p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.keyword}, '%'), 0) AS mt_name, IFNULL(p.tags LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.keyword}, '%'), 0) AS mt_tag FROM t_playlist p WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1 AND p.is_public = 1 AND p.audit_status = 1 HAVING score > 0
AND (score, p.hot_score, p.id) < (#{pos.score}, #{pos.hotScore}, #{pos.id})
ORDER BY score DESC, p.hot_score DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT p.id, ( 5 * (p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.keyword}, '%')) + IFNULL(2 * (p.tags LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.keyword}, '%')), 0) ) AS score FROM t_playlist p WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1 AND p.is_public = 1 AND p.audit_status = 1 HAVING score > 0 ) c

SELECT a.id, a.name, a.avatar AS cover, a.song_count, a.hot_score FROM t_artist a WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.status = 1 AND ( a.name LIKE CONCAT(#{kw}, '%') OR IFNULL(a.name_pinyin LIKE CONCAT(#{py}, '%'), 0) = 1 OR (IFNULL(a.name_pinyin_first LIKE CONCAT(#{py}, '%'), 0) = 1 AND CHAR_LENGTH(#{py}) >= 2) ) ORDER BY a.hot_score DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT s.id, s.name, s.artist_id, s.artist_name, s.cover, s.hot_score FROM t_song s WHERE s.deleted = 0 AND s.status = 1 AND s.audit_status = 1 AND s.copyright_status = 1 AND ( s.name LIKE CONCAT(#{kw}, '%') OR IFNULL(s.name_pinyin LIKE CONCAT(#{py}, '%'), 0) = 1 OR (IFNULL(s.name_pinyin_first LIKE CONCAT(#{py}, '%'), 0) = 1 AND CHAR_LENGTH(#{py}) >= 2) ) ORDER BY s.hot_score DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT al.id, al.name, al.cover, al.artist_name, al.song_count, al.hot_score FROM t_album al WHERE al.deleted = 0 AND al.status = 1 AND ( al.name LIKE CONCAT(#{kw}, '%') OR IFNULL(al.name_pinyin LIKE CONCAT(#{py}, '%'), 0) = 1 OR (IFNULL(al.name_pinyin_first LIKE CONCAT(#{py}, '%'), 0) = 1 AND CHAR_LENGTH(#{py}) >= 2) ) ORDER BY al.hot_score DESC, al.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.id, p.name, p.cover, p.song_count, p.play_count, p.hot_score FROM t_playlist p WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1 AND p.is_public = 1 AND p.audit_status = 1 AND p.name LIKE CONCAT(#{kw}, '%') ORDER BY p.hot_score DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
